processor: arm64 (Apple silicon, 10 logical cores); the exact chip model could not be read inside the sandbox
time_measurement: time.perf_counter() around deduplicate(), tracemalloc off, corpus construction excluded
memory_measurement: tracemalloc peak of allocations made during deduplicate() (separate run), and peak resident set size of the whole process
statistic: median of the repetitions, with minimum and maximum
environment_source: Processor family, core count and memory are the figures reported by the host that ran the benchmark; sysctl is blocked in the sandbox, so benchmark_dedup.py could not read them itself.
note: Measured on the working tree of release 1.2.0 (deduplication code identical to the tag). An earlier run of the same script gave about 20% shorter times and identical memory.
